newsitem.title: UK: UK Flotta cancels August one cargo, defers others.
newsitem.headline: UK Flotta cancels August one cargo, defers others.

text.p: One of 11 North Sea Flotta blend crude oil cargoes scheduled to load in August was cancelled because of lower than expected production at a contributory field, traders said on Wednesday.
The cancelled cargo, equity belonging to Conoco, was scheduled to load on August 29-31.
The remaining 10 August Flotta cargoes have been deferred by 3-4 days apiece, the traders said.
Flotta orginally was scheduled to lift 6.3 million barrels in total in August.
